metadata.contract_type: Firm Fixed Price (Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee Basis of Estimate)

direct_labor.description: Direct labor hours aligned with the 6-month Phase I work plan (Tasks 1-4) in Volume 2.

direct_materials_and_equipment.description: Hardware and test equipment required for the bare-metal HIL validation on STM32H743 / Pixhawk 6X.

line_items.item: SEGGER J-Link Ultra+ / ST-Link V3 Debug Probes

other_direct_costs.description: Cloud Emulation and HIL Digital Twin Test Infrastructure required to execute the eight DOEs at realistic scale.

line_items.item: Cloud Emulation & HIL Digital Twin Test Infrastructure

basis_of_estimate.labor_rates: Hourly rates are based on fiscal-year 2026 loaded salary surveys for the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area and prevailing rates for defense SBIR Phase I work. The PI rate reflects systems-architecture and SBIR principal-investigator responsibility; the Senior Embedded Engineer rate reflects Rust, ARM Cortex-M7, and safety-critical firmware experience.
basis_of_estimate.indirect_rates: Fringe (30.00%), Overhead (40.00%), and G&A (15.00%) are provisional rates for Atelier Logic Group LLC for the 2026 fiscal year. These rates are consistent with the company's disclosed cost accounting practices and will be finalized in the cost accounting disclosure statement submitted at award.
basis_of_estimate.materials: Equipment quantities are sized for the 6-month hardware-in-the-loop validation: three Pixhawk 6X-class development rigs for host/target equivalence and fault-injection experiments, two professional debug probes for on-chip tracing, and one high-speed logic analyzer for timing verification of the deterministic 128-cycle kernel.
basis_of_estimate.fee: Fixed fee is calculated at 10.027% of total estimated cost, equal to $18,226.40, within the SBIR Phase I fee ceiling.
basis_of_estimate.odcs: The $13,880.00 Other Direct Costs line funds Cloud Emulation and HIL Digital Twin Test Infrastructure required to execute the eight DOEs at realistic scale, including on-demand cloud compute for Monte Carlo SIL parameter sweeps, containerized firmware-in-the-loop regression runners, and persistent artifact storage for host/target equivalence traces.
